messages:
Ava: Heads-upFinBank needs explicit answers for EU-only POC. Questions: can we guarantee no US subprocessors for a pinned EU tenant? Also need BYOK phrasing and rough cost delta for reserving EU Dedicated capacity.

Diego: Short answer: yes for Dedicated/Private with strict pinning + capacity fencing. No for Hosted. Sending formal text and subprocessor list.

Priya: Important: customer will require audit logs to remain in the EU. Can we confirm log storage placement for Dedicated and Hosted?

Diego: Dedicated: logs tied to tenant storage in EU by default when pinned. Hosted: logs may be replicated across regions for operational reasons. Will confirm replication policy and retention locations.

Sam: On pricing: reserving EU capacity typically adds 15-30% depending on instance class and commit term. Egress differences minimal if talking intra-EU. I'll give 3 examples (small/medium/high commit).

Ava: For the questionnaire please provide a one-line for subprocessors and one-line for KMS so Legal can paste directly.

Diego: Suggested wording for subprocessors: "For Dedicated and Private deployments configured with strict EU-only routing and capacity fencing, Redwood does not route customer data to US subprocessors. Hosted customers may use subprocessors in multiple regions depending on routing and capacity."

Diego: Suggested KMS wording: "Customer-managed keys (BYOK) are supported for Dedicated and Private deployments and can be provisioned within the customer's EU cloud account/region. Hosted deployments use Redwood-managed keys located in the region assigned to the deployment."

Priya: @LegalBot do we need any additional qualifier about legal access or emergency cross-border processing?

LegalBot: Addendum: include this sentence if customer requests: "In the event of a lawful access request, Redwood will only disclose customer data in accordance with applicable law and will notify the customer unless prohibited."

Ava: Perfect. Diego please attach the EU subprocessor list and the pricing ranges. Priya, Sam can you confirm log placement semantics by EOD?

Sam: Yep, I'll confirm log buckets and replication flags today.

Diego: Uploading subprocessor CSV + pricing range to the shared deck now.

Ava: Thanks all I'll update the RFP response and send to the customer after those attachments are in.
